senses.gloss:
Mulālin (masc.) or Mulālī (fem.) is the name of some part
of an edible lotus (perhaps the Nymphaea esculenta) in the
Atharvaveda.^1
1) iv. 34. 5. Cf. Kauśika Sūtra,
lxvi. 10; Weber, Indische Studien, 18,
138; Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 70;
Whitney, Translation of the Atharva-
veda, 207.
